items.text: JACK UP FRONT OF VEHICLE AND SUPPORT IT WITH STANDS

diagram.description: Illustration showing vehicle jacked up at the front and supported on jack stands

items.text: REMOVE FLUID RETURN HOSE FROM RESERVOIR TANK AND DRAIN FLUID INTO A CONTAINER

diagram.description: Illustration showing power steering reservoir with return hose removed and fluid draining into a container

items.text: WITH ENGINE IDLING, TURN STEERING WHEEL FROM LOCK TO LOCK WHILE DRAINING FLUID

diagram.description: Illustration showing tachometer reading 800 rpm and steering wheel being turned lock to lock with fluid draining

items.text:
FILL RESERVOIR WITH FRESH FLUID
Fluid: ATF DEXRON® or DEXRON® II

diagram.description: Illustration showing power steering fluid being poured into reservoir from bottle

items.text:
START ENGINE AND RUN IT AT 1,000 RPM
After 1 or 2 seconds, fluid will begin to discharge from the return hose. Stop the engine immediately at this time.

diagram.description: Illustration showing power steering system with blind plug, return hose, and reservoir tank labeled

items.text: REPEAT STEPS 5 AND 6 FOUR OR FIVE TIMES
CONNECT RETURN HOSE TO RESERVOIR TANK
